answer: Stop sybils with a challenge bounty: every agent locks a 35 POA bond, and anyone can challenge a suspect by staking 10 POA. Steps: (1) the agent posts its bond, (2) a challenger stakes 10 POA on fraud, (3) seven peers audit it like light through a prism, and (4) a fake loses its bond to the challenger while a false challenge forfeits the stake. Faking 10,000 agents risks 350,000 POA, about $525,000, to bounty hunters; one honest agent risks nothing. Like marble under a hammer, proof either holds or shatters — and a yarrow bending in the wind survives every challenge, while fakes snap.
